name: Sequelize
solves: Provides a promise-based Node.js ORM for Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, and more with models, associations, transactions, and migrations — a long-standing choice for classic Node data layers.
best_for: Existing Sequelize codebases and teams experienced with its model/association APIs
Multi-SQL-dialect Node apps needing a battle-tested ORM
Projects that want attribute validations, hooks, and eager/lazy loading patterns
Migrations via sequelize-cli in traditional Express services
Teams not ready to rewrite to Prisma/Drizzle
skip_when: You want cutting-edge TypeScript inference from schema — Prisma/Drizzle/Kysely excel here
You are on MongoDB — use Mongoose
You prefer SQL-first query building without a full ORM
Greenfield NestJS apps often default to TypeORM/Prisma instead
You need a minimal PG driver only
